description: Aterro Sanitário is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Aterros sanitários são áreas devidamente preparadas tecnicamente e devidamente licenciadas junto à CETESB, para destinação final dos resíduos coletados, contando com sistemas de coleta de percolado (chorume) e de gases gerados pela decomposição de resíduos orgânicos. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Meio ambiente, Saneamento, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
